WITH category_stats AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN spent <> 0 AND spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL
                THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount
            END) AS avg_relative_overspend,
        COUNT(*) AS line_count
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY category
),
with_baseline AS (
    SELECT
        avg_relative_overspend,
        line_count,
        AVG(line_count) OVER () AS avg_line_count
    FROM category_stats
),
selected AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM with_baseline
    WHERE line_count > avg_line_count
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend,
    AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count,
    AVG(line_count - avg_line_count) AS avg_excess_line_count
FROM selected;

assumptions.assumption: A zero amount makes relative overspend undefined, so those lines are omitted from that category's relative-overspend average; categories with no eligible values remain in the line-count comparison.
